recent.name: Perception leaf-NOVELTY BUILD — MindsOS chain (in-sandbox) + CNN baseline (Linux, authored) + audit
recent.what: Built the LEAF_NOVELTY_PREREG v2 experiment. MindsOS numpy leaf-chain (pixel->point->segment->polygon{3,4}+withholdable arc; learned tau/eps + per-leaf Platt; RDP vertex-count irreducibility -> REQUEST_ATOM; analysis-by-synthesis grounding). In-sandbox results (3 seeds, AUDITED TRUSTWORTHY by an independent ML-advocate subagent): P0 in-vocab acc 0.961+/-0.006 (LEARNED-FAIR, not baked - verified no generator-param leakage); MP1 no-fabrication on clean circles 0.0 (temptation 0.34, non-trivial); MP2 repair retention EXACTLY 1.0 (0/480 flip - arc leaf is a fallback, never overrides a polygon) + curved acc 0.965 + 1 leaf added/0 re-fit; near-miss request-atom curve 0.0->0.045->0.6->0.967 (the predicted P17 continuous blind spot, reported-not-gated per AM-3). Strong CNN+OOD+3-repair-mode baseline AUTHORED for the user's Linux (torch; unrun in sandbox like discovery_test.py) - includes the audit-mandated row-frozen warm-started head (AM-5) as the ML-advocate's best shot. 3 pre-build amendments (AM-2 learned-not-baked def; AM-3 MP1 clean-only + near-miss reported; AM-4 novelty=conjunction-at-parity) + AM-5 (baseline strengthened post-audit) recorded in PREREG sec.8 before the affected runs.

recent.note: COMPLETE + AUDITED 2026-06-29 (runs 1-5 on Linux). FINAL VERDICT (honest, no spin): P0 parity PASSES (CNN 0.967 vs MindsOS 0.961, earned/learned-not-baked). BUT the strong novelty claim does NOT stand: (1) headline 'retention 1.0 vs CNN 0.792' is a UNIT MISMATCH (MindsOS=zero-flip delta @abs 0.954; CNN=absolute-capped) -> matched 0.954 vs 0.792; (2) fresh modular CNN detector AUROC 0.995 -> the gap is sample-efficiency + crisp-categorical routing, NOT a ROC-frontier impossibility; (3) no-fabrication CONCEDED (CNN Mahalanobis OOD 0.953). Conjunction-at-parity (AM-4) holds ONLY as the NARROWER claim = data-efficient crisp-symbolic routing + named/inspectable request-atom (gap-naming), which v1 deliberately does not contest (PB-K). Mechanism substrate-contingent (erodes off the clean discrete grid; MindsOS already blind in near-miss). Baseline strengthened 4x per pre-committed anti-strawman rule (AM-6/7/8/9); 1 BatchNorm-eval bug caught+fixed (AM-10). Full study-1 record: PERCEPTION_LEAF_NOVELTY_PREREG.md sec.9 FINAL VERDICT + sec.8 AM-1..AM-10. recent.name: Perception leaf — cross-family confidence study + leaf-novelty pre-reg (v2)
recent.what: Audited empirical study: does the two-axis confidence + per-capacity-calibration leaf-contract generalize? Synthetic scoring/retrieval/derivation + real-data FrameNet frame-disambiguation. Findings (CROSSFAMILY_PREREG §10/§11): both axes generalize beyond perception, but WHICH axis carries correctness is family-dependent (selection→decision, entailment→grounding); two-axis independence requires proposer≠critic; per-capacity calibration is CONDITIONAL (only under incommensurability); near-vocab blind-spot is continuous-substrate-ONLY (absent in discrete); grounding = inverse-critic anchored at a REFERENCE (floor=perception special case). Real-data = TRUSTWORTHY-PARTIAL (decision transfers qualitatively, risk-coverage 6.5x; AUROC degrades synth 0.83→real 0.745). PIVOT (user-driven): the confidence work is ORTHOGONAL to the real MindsOS novelty; designed (pre-registered, NOT built) the LEAF-NOVELTY test = learned-but-NAMED-atom leaves + irreducibility→request-atom→one-shot-repair vs a strong CNN+OOD baseline at noise-parity.
